title: Trend Forecasting

variables.name: type
variables.reason: Forecasts use aggregate time series, not per-title content metadata.
variables.treatment: Only content type defines All/Movie/TV scope; other metadata does not enter the model.

variables.reason: Forecasts use aggregate time series, not per-title content metadata.
variables.treatment: Only content type defines All/Movie/TV scope; other metadata does not enter the model.

variables.treatment: Only content type defines All/Movie/TV scope; other metadata does not enter the model.

variables.name: duration
variables.reason: Forecasts use aggregate time series, not per-title content metadata.
variables.treatment: Only content type defines All/Movie/TV scope; other metadata does not enter the model.

variables.name: release_year
variables.reason: Measures original release cohort; it is distinct from date added.

variables.name: date_added
variables.reason: Measures catalog entry, not original release.

variables.name: rating
variables.reason: Advisory ratings are not viewer scores, commercial success or clustering ground truth.
variables.treatment: Never used as a model feature or performance label.

variables.name: director
variables.reason: High cardinality is outside the chosen geometry/time-series feature set.

variables.name: show_id / title
variables.reason: Trace records and remove repeated entities; unique identifiers do not describe generalizable content.
variables.treatment: Exclude from features; title/type/year supports entity review.

variables.name: lags / trailing means / trend / seasonality
variables.reason: Past counts, local averages and calendar cycles describe persistence, trend and seasonal changes.
variables.treatment: Only observations before the predicted period enter each feature; recursively use predictions for unknown future lags.

decisions.reason: date_added is not an original release date; combining them would change the target without disclosure.
decisions.evidence: Six separately recorded series; annual 2000–2020 and monthly 2015-01–2021-08.
decisions.limitation: One retrospective catalog snapshot has survivorship/backfill bias and is not a point-in-time archive.

decisions.reason: A partial year/month would artificially lower recent counts.
decisions.evidence: Exclude 592 2021 release-cohort titles and 183 September additions from modeling.
decisions.limitation: Exclusion does not establish that older cohorts are complete.

decisions.action: Freeze selection before the chronological test
decisions.reason: Test results must reveal failure rather than retrospectively select a better model.
decisions.evidence: Annual CV winner has test MAE 2395.37 versus last-value 137.75; the failure remains visible.
decisions.limitation: Exploratory CV error bands are not calibrated confidence intervals or reliable current forecasts.

stages.name: Source validation
stages.reason: Verify the supplied SHA-256, schema, types and duration units.

stages.name: Entity deduplication
stages.reason: Remove 7 repeated entities; preserve both independent time concepts.

split_strategy: Annual: 17 development years / 4 test years for each content scope. Monthly: 74 development months / 6 test months. These are period counts, not randomly split title rows. No row-level train/test ratio is fabricated.
limitations: This is the supplied historical catalog snapshot, not a current Netflix data feed.
Decisions are concise, evidence-backed summaries; model outputs do not establish causation.
